THESE APPEALS, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.
Both the insurer and the claimants are in appeal.

2. It is not in dispute that as a result of the motor vehicle accident which occurred on 02.04.2017,
K.Naveen, a 19 year old died.
3. The principal contention of the insurer is that the Tribunal has mis-applied the amendment of the year 2019 and granted a sum of Rs.5,00,000/-.
4. The claimants, on the other hand, contended that the compensation awarded was inadequate.

5. It is noticed that even if the structured formula is applied and the amendment is ignored, the claimants would nevertheless, be entitled to Rs.4,26,000/- as against Rs.5,04,500/- awarded by the The Reliance General Insurance Company ... vs Annapoorna K on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33870125/
3

entities.text: Reliance General Insurance Company ... vs Annapoorna K
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Tribunal.

In my view, having regard to the difference of compensation would only be about Rs.80,000/- and also noticing the fact that the claimants were not awarded any amount towards 'loss of consortium' and under the 'conventional heads', in my view, the interest of justice would be served by affirming the award Rs.5,04,500/- to the claimants.
6. However, the Tribunal has committed an error in awarding interest at the rate of 9% per annum and in its place it is held that the claimants are entitled for interest at the rate of 6% per annum.
The rate of interest is modified and the award of the Tribunal is confirmed.
7. The appeals filed by claimants and insurer are accordingly disposed of.
8. It is also contended by the insurer that there was contributory negligence on the part of the deceased.
In a proceeding under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1989, the question of negligence would have no application at all and therefore, this contention is rejected.

9. On such deposit, the claimants are entitled to withdraw the same as per the terms of the award of the Tribunal.
10.
The amount in deposit, if any, shall be transferred to the Tribunal forthwith.

Sd/-
